parameters.name: CheckJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data validation task.

parameters.name: CheckType
parameters.description:
The data validation method. Valid values:

- **1**: full data validation.
- **2**: incremental data validation.
- **3**: all.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query the ID.

parameters.name: JobName
parameters.description: The name of the data migration or data synchronization task.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.
